answer: The key breaks before the answer does. Rotate the session key each epoch and tie the new one to a signed work receipt. Old keys die on schedule. Convert rewards into a 30-epoch vesting stream, so nobody withdraws early. A velvet wrapper of good-looking accounts does not help when the key has to be re-earned every epoch. A sparrow of stolen sessions dies at the first rotation. The fable of passive income from parked identities ends at epoch 31 with nothing vested.
